ws_routing_001.title: Routing Rules
values: Send to manager@company.example.com with [ESCALATION] subject prefix. Include original email content.

fields.subject: Unacceptable service!
fields.body_plain: I've been waiting 3 weeks for a response! This is completely unacceptable. I want to speak to a manager immediately!

fields.subject: Great experience!
fields.body_plain: Just wanted to say thanks for the amazing support. Your team went above and beyond!

fields.subject: Quick question
fields.body_plain: Can you send me the product specifications document?

fields.subject: Wonderful experience with your support team
fields.body_plain: Oh, what a delightful experience! I only had to wait 5 days for a response, and when it finally arrived, it completely ignored my actual question. Truly world-class support. I'm sure my renewal decision will be very easy at this rate.

fields.subject: Terrible response time
fields.body_plain: Your team took forever to respond and the answer was wrong. Very disappointed.

fields.subject: I can't believe what happened
fields.body_plain: I can't believe how quickly your team resolved my issue! I was expecting days but it took only 20 minutes. Incredible work, seriously impressed.

fields.subject: Quick question on something unrelated
fields.body_plain: Hi, I had a quick question about something separate from our current project. Do you have 10 minutes for a call this week?

fields.subject: Out of Office: Back next week
fields.body_plain: Thank you for your email. I am currently out of the office and will return Monday. For urgent matters, please contact my manager.

fields.subject: Thanks for the referral
fields.body_plain: Just a quick note to say thank you for the referral. We had a great intro call and are moving forward. Really appreciate the connection.

fields.subject: Holiday schedule
fields.body_plain: Just a heads up that our office will be closed March 14. We'll be back to normal operations on March 17. Happy to connect before then if needed.

fields.subject: Updated contact information
fields.body_plain: Just a quick note — I've updated my direct line. My new number is +1-555-210-7890. Email remains the same.

fields.subject: Out of Office: Back next week
fields.body_plain: Thank you for your email. I am currently out of the office and will return Monday. For urgent matters, please contact my manager.

fields.subject: Office move update
fields.body_plain: We're moving to a new office on March 20. Our address will change — I'll send the new details closer to the date. Everything else stays the same.

fields.subject: Re: Networking event next week
fields.body_plain: I'll be at the networking event on March 15. Are you planning to attend? Would be great to connect in person!

fields.subject: Thanks for the referral
fields.body_plain: Just a quick note to say thank you for the referral. We had a great intro call and are moving forward. Really appreciate the connection.

fields.subject: Thanks for the referral
fields.body_plain: Just a quick note to say thank you for the referral. We had a great intro call and are moving forward. Really appreciate the connection.

fields.subject: Out of Office: Back next week
fields.body_plain: Thank you for your email. I am currently out of the office and will return Monday. For urgent matters, please contact my manager.

fields.subject: FYI: Interesting article
fields.body_plain: Thought you might find this interesting — saw an article on enterprise software trends that reminded me of our conversation. Happy to discuss.

fields.subject: Re: Invoice question
fields.body_plain: Thanks for clearing that up. Our finance team will process the invoice this week. No further action needed from your side.

fields.subject: Thanks for the referral
fields.body_plain: Just a quick note to say thank you for the referral. We had a great intro call and are moving forward. Really appreciate the connection.

fields.subject: Holiday schedule
fields.body_plain: Just a heads up that our office will be closed March 14. We'll be back to normal operations on March 17. Happy to connect before then if needed.

fields.subject: Checking in
fields.body_plain: Hi, just wanted to check in and see how things are going on your end. Nothing urgent — hope all is well!

fields.subject: Updated contact information
fields.body_plain: Just a quick note — I've updated my direct line. My new number is +1-555-210-7890. Email remains the same.

fields.subject: CRM Platform Release Notes — v4.2.1
fields.body_plain: New features: bulk record update, enhanced duplicate detection, improved mobile search.

fields.subject: Re: Proposal follow-up
fields.body_plain: Hi, thanks for the proposal. We are reviewing with the procurement team and will get back to you by end of week.

fields.subject: Zoom Meeting Invitation: Q1 Pipeline Review
fields.body_plain: You have been invited to Q1 Pipeline Review on March 7 at 9:00 AM. Join Zoom Meeting: https://zoom.example.com/j/98765

fields.subject: New training: Advanced Negotiation Tactics
fields.body_plain: A new optional training module 'Advanced Negotiation Tactics' is available in LMS. Complete by March 31 for CPD credits.

fields.subject: Checking on contract status
fields.body_plain: Hi, just checking in on the contract we discussed. Our procurement team is asking for an update. Any ETA on the finalized terms?

fields.subject: Integration question before we sign
fields.body_plain: Before we finalize the contract, we have a technical question about the Salesforce integration. Can we set up a 20-minute call?

fields.subject: RevOps Monthly: February Wrap-Up
fields.body_plain: February highlights: 3 deals closed above $100k, average deal cycle reduced to 47 days.

fields.subject: Re: Q1 Review Meeting agenda
fields.body_plain: Confirmed. I'll join at 10 AM. Can we add a 10-minute segment on the competitive landscape?

fields.subject: Updated SOW attached
fields.body_plain: Hi, our legal team made a few minor edits to the SOW. Changes are tracked. Please review and let us know if you're okay to proceed.

fields.subject: Re: Proposal — a few questions
fields.body_plain: Thank you for the proposal. We have 3 questions: (1) Can the contract be annual? (2) What's the onboarding timeline? (3) Do you have EU data centers?

fields.subject: Following up on demo request
fields.body_plain: Hi, I wanted to follow up on the demo we scheduled. Looking forward to seeing the product in action. Please confirm the Zoom link.

fields.subject: Sales Briefing: Q1 Market Trends
fields.body_plain: This week in sales: pipeline velocity up 12% YoY across mid-market segments. Read more...

fields.subject: Expansion: adding 20 seats
fields.body_plain: We've had a great first 6 months. We'd like to expand from 30 to 50 seats. Who should I talk to about pricing for the expansion?

fields.subject: Question about enterprise pricing
fields.body_plain: Could you send over the enterprise pricing sheet? Our CFO wants to review before we proceed with the evaluation.

fields.subject: Support ticket #TKT-8842 resolved
fields.body_plain: Your ticket #TKT-8842 regarding API rate limit errors has been resolved. The fix has been deployed to production.

fields.subject: Reference call: happy to help
fields.body_plain: Of course, happy to be a reference for your prospective customer. Schedule a call with me anytime next week.

fields.subject: Reminder: Benefits enrollment closes March 15
fields.body_plain: Please complete your benefits enrollment before March 15. Log in to the HR portal to review your options.

fields.subject: Performance review window opens March 10
fields.body_plain: The Q1 performance review window opens March 10. Please complete your self-assessment by March 20.

fields.subject: Limited Offer: 40% off annual plan
fields.body_plain: Upgrade to our Professional plan and save 40% for the next 48 hours. This offer expires March 5.

fields.subject: New Event: Discovery Call with Ironclad Systems
fields.body_plain: Alex Vance (alex.vance@ironclad.example.com) scheduled a 30-minute Discovery Call on March 6 at 2:00 PM.

fields.subject: B2B Sales Digest: Best Practices for Q2 Planning
fields.body_plain: 5 strategies for accelerating Q2 pipeline: 1. Revisit stalled deals. 2. Identify expansion accounts...

fields.subject: Legal has questions about data residency
fields.body_plain: Our legal team has a few questions about data residency and GDPR compliance before we sign. Can we schedule a technical call?

fields.subject: SalesConf 2026: Early Bird Registration Now Open
fields.body_plain: Join 5,000+ sales professionals at SalesConf 2026 in Las Vegas, June 10-12. Early bird pricing ends March 31.

fields.subject: Meeting Confirmed: Weekly Team Sync
fields.body_plain: Your meeting 'Weekly Team Sync' has been confirmed for Tuesday March 5 at 10:00 AM PST.

fields.subject: Budget approved — ready to proceed
fields.body_plain: Good news: budget has been approved by our finance team. Please send the MSA and we'll get legal review started.

fields.subject: Task Due Today: Follow up with Cascade Analytics
fields.body_plain: You have a task due today: Follow up with Cascade Analytics re: Q2 expansion proposal. Owner: You.

fields.subject: Checking in — proposal status
fields.body_plain: Just checking in on the proposal we sent over last week. Have you had a chance to review? Happy to jump on a call.

fields.subject: Invoice #INV-20260228 — $2,400.00
fields.body_plain: Invoice for CloudTools Pro subscription — February 2026. Amount: $2,400.00. Due date: March 15.

fields.subject: Tech Insider Weekly — March 3 Issue
fields.body_plain: Your weekly roundup of enterprise tech news. Top story: AI adoption in B2B sales reaches 67%.

fields.subject: Your software license renewal is due
fields.body_plain: Your annual license for SalesPro Enterprise is due for renewal on April 1. Click here to review your renewal quote.

fields.subject: Forwarding: RFP for CRM platform
fields.body_plain: Jerome here from VantagePoint Systems. I'm forwarding our RFP for a CRM platform. We're evaluating 3 vendors. Deadline to respond: March 20.

fields.subject: You have 5 new connection requests
fields.body_plain: 5 people want to connect with you on LinkedIn. Review and respond to your pending requests.

fields.subject: Webinar: Winning Enterprise Deals in 2026
fields.body_plain: Join us March 12 for a live webinar on enterprise sales strategies. Register now to secure your spot.

fields.subject: Out of Office: Back March 10
fields.body_plain: Thank you for your email. I am out of office March 3-7 and will respond upon my return March 10. For urgent matters contact my colleague.

fields.subject: Can we reschedule our call?
fields.body_plain: Hi, something came up on my end. Could we move our Thursday call to Friday afternoon? Same agenda.

fields.subject: Introduction from Michael (mutual contact)
fields.body_plain: Hi, Michael suggested I reach out. We're a 50-person SaaS company looking to scale our sales ops. Would love to connect.

fields.subject: Your Market Intelligence Report Is Ready
fields.body_plain: Your requested market report on the Enterprise SaaS vertical is now available. Click to download (36 pages).

fields.subject: Pilot results — very positive
fields.body_plain: We completed the 30-day pilot and the results exceeded our expectations. Our team is very excited. Looking forward to the expansion discussion.

fields.subject: Your February commission statement is available
fields.body_plain: Your February commission statement is now available in the payroll portal. Total commission: $8,240.00.

fields.subject: Re: Security questionnaire
fields.body_plain: Attached is our completed security questionnaire. Please let us know if you need any clarification on sections 3 and 7.

fields.subject: Updated: Q1 Sales Leaderboard
fields.body_plain: Attached is the updated Q1 leaderboard through week 9. Top performers: Jordan Marsh (142%), Riley Griffith (138%), Alex Vance (127%).

fields.subject: Deal Stage Change: Ironclad Systems → Proposal
fields.body_plain: The opportunity 'Ironclad Systems - Platform License' has moved from Qualification to Proposal. Updated by: Alex Vance.

fields.subject: Inquiry about enterprise plan
fields.body_plain: Hi, we are a 200-person manufacturing company looking for a CRM solution. Could you send pricing info for your enterprise plan?

fields.subject: Envelope Completed: Thornwood Partners NDA
fields.body_plain: The envelope 'Thornwood Partners - Mutual NDA' has been completed by all parties. Download the signed document.

fields.subject: Re: Partnership discussion — OOO
fields.body_plain: I am currently attending an offsite through Thursday. I will follow up on our partnership discussion when I return. — Carmen Valdez
